_about: The regression catalogue: failure CATEGORIES learned from real incidents. Each category gets a named canary — a test that recreates the incident's conditions and asserts the fix holds, forever. 'status' tracks the canary, not the bug (all listed bugs are fixed). status values: live-scratchpad (working check exists but lives in a session scratchpad — needs banking into qa/), to-build, live-suite (in the versioned suite; none yet), retired.

canaries.rule: Changing how a chip LOOKS (pickable flag, lock dim, selection outline) must never change where anything SITS.
canaries.incident: Pickable scatter — four rounds of fixes, 2026-07-15; root causes ranged from cache-key churn to a CSS position flip. Tasks: BOARD-PICKSCATTER1.
canaries.assertion: toggle pickable/lock/selection on the demo board → 0 of N chips move (style.left/top byte-identical)

canaries.rule: The walls the physics enforces must be the shapes the player sees (rim ellipse, hub circle, screen edge) — not approximations that only match on some screens.
canaries.incident: Circular walls vs oval rim, 2026-07-16 — every radial wall was a circle sampled at the segment mid-angle; square screens hid it, portrait exposed it. Found by the 🧪 zone-walls overlay.
canaries.assertion: at portrait AND landscape: every basket chip fully inside the rim ellipse, every store chip fully outside it (corner test against env.oval)
canaries.suite: CHIPCANARY-01 — centre-test v1 (full corner test vs env.oval still to build)

canaries.rule: Nothing interactive may sit off-screen or under the floating banner/footer.
canaries.incident: Chips cut off the visible screen in both layouts (BOARD-SAFEAREA1, 2026-07-15).
canaries.assertion: 0 chips outside the measured safe rect (banner bottom / footer top / side margins) in any tested state

canaries.rule: Anything attached to a chip (dotted trade lines, after-glow trails, ghost alignment) must move WITH the chip, always.
canaries.incident: Stale dotted lines after chips moved, 2026-07-16 (and the earlier kinked-trails bug, 2026-07-14). Fixed with per-frame re-anchoring.
canaries.assertion: after a forced re-layout, every trail/trade-line endpoint sits within 4px of its chip's centre

canaries.rule: Every animation must terminate: after the board settles, nothing moves until something real changes.
canaries.incident: Jitter reports on tablet, 2026-07-16 — one cause was shelf targets fighting the wall clamp every frame.
canaries.assertion: max chip movement 0.0px/frame over a 30-frame watch after settle, in shelves AND organic

canaries.rule: Every chip the game says exists must be drawn, positioned, on every render — including mid- and post-animation.
canaries.incident: Ghost NFTs vanishing / spotlight wiping everything to top-left, 2026-07-16 — re-rendered elements never received their position when the body hadn't moved.
canaries.assertion: 0 unplaced elements (no style.left), 0 elements at the top-left default, ghosts + NFT ghosts present; checked static, mid-replay and post-replay

canaries.rule: A button must not move between the moment you aim and the moment you click — async loading may never grow the page under your finger.
canaries.incident: SIGN-LAYOUTJUMP1 — the signing modal grew during enrichment and a mainnet Sign click landed on a hashtag link instead. The dangerous category: mis-clicks with real value at stake.
canaries.assertion: the Sign button's bounding box is identical from first paint through full enrichment (Playwright bounding-box watch over the hydration window)
canaries.fixture: signing modal (needs backend or recorded tx fixture)

canaries.rule: If a thing can be dismissed/expanded/acted on, its control must be visibly present.
canaries.incident: GM-TOAST-X1 — toasts had no visible close ✕.
canaries.assertion: every toast shows a visible ✕ within its bounds
canaries.fixture: any page that toasts; demo board can trigger them

canaries.rule: Flight animations must start where the thing actually was, and end where it actually lands.
canaries.incident: NFT offers 'flying in from nowhere' (ghost origin had spilled off-screen); kinked trail lines from mid-glide rects (2026-07-14).
canaries.assertion: every flight's start rect within Npx of the source chip's last painted rect; end rect within Npx of the destination chip

canaries.rule: Key containers keep their intended proportions — a refactor elsewhere must not silently shrink them.
canaries.incident: SIGN-CARDWIDTH1 — account cards went narrow around the protobuf change.
canaries.assertion: named containers ≥ expected fraction of their parent's width at desktop viewport
